title: Delivering many projects: requests scored with reasons, K chosen of N with their reuse, and projects nobody uses flagged from the workspace's records
request: Phase 8 Part G, the owner's pattern 11: fifteen requests and capacity for five; the success number agreed before building; a project nobody used flagged to retire.
plan: Request and Portfolio contracts; a score on value, readiness, effort and risk, each with its reason.
choose: K of N, never one without its success number, the reuse said.
retire: no use for a period, from the workspace's own records.

decisions.decision: A project's use is its newest event in the experience log or its own last change.
decisions.why: An outcome observed, a stage run or a chat are each a use, and all are events already.

decisions.decision: A never-used project is flagged only once it is older than the period.
decisions.why: A project made yesterday has had no time to be used.

change: dclab_core.triage (Request v1, Score, Portfolio v1, score, choose, retire with created); dclab_rnd.triage (last_use, unused, python -m dclab_rnd.triage).

findings.defect: A project made yesterday was flagged to retire.
findings.scenario: A never-used project with no age check.
findings.fix: A never-used project is flagged only when made before the cut; with no date it is not.

findings.defect: Nothing in the studio read a project's use.
findings.fix: dclab_rnd.triage reads each project's last use from the experience log and the project.

findings.defect: The test did not pin which five were chosen.
findings.scenario: A change of weights would pass unseen.
findings.cause: The test checked only the order of scores.

measurements.name: fifteen written requests, capacity five
measurements.gate: five chosen with reasons, none without a success number, reuse said
measurements.result: five chosen, the same five the test pins; two requests not ready (no success number), never chosen; reuse found among the chosen
limits: Fifteen requests written for the test; the weights are a first choice, not measured.

outcome: The owner can see which requests to build first and why, what they share, and which projects nobody uses, with the choice left to a person.
lessons: Pin a choice the test exists for; an ordering check alone lets a regression through.
risks: The weights are a first choice, unmeasured against real outcomes.
